evidence.title: CodePen - Online Code Editor For Building & Deploying Websites

name: CodePen
summary: Online code editor and social community for building, sharing and deploying front-end pens and websites.
description: Browser-based editor for HTML, CSS and JavaScript with files and folders, compiler blocks for Sass, TypeScript, Tailwind, JSX and ESM, instant preview, version history and real-time collaboration. Public Pens are open source by default and searchable for inspiration, and any Pen can be deployed to a live URL; free tier plus PRO plans from $8/mo.
contains: editor with files and folders, compiler blocks and instant preview
compiler supports Sass, TypeScript, Tailwind, JSX and ESM modules without setup
unlimited public Pens, collections and templates; private Pens on PRO
every save is a version with previews and rollback; realtime and async collaboration
deploy any Pen to a live URL; custom domains and asset hosting on PRO
free plan: 3 files per Pen; PRO Starter $8/mo, Developer $12/mo, Super $26/mo
community Pens are public and open source by default
